speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. To begin my assessment, have you noticed any specific changes in your bowel habits or stool color regarding your abdominal pain?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: The symptoms of B-symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss) combined with supraclavicular lymphadenopathy and abdominal pain are highly concerning for a malignancy. Have you noticed any lumps or swelling in your neck, armpits, or groin, and do you have any history of alcohol consumption?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.
